fields.YouTube title: India’s AI Infrastructure Is Growing | L&T’s ₹2,500–5,000 Crore Order
fields.YouTube description (includes hashtags):
India is expanding the infrastructure behind advanced artificial intelligence.

On 23 November 2026, Larsen & Toubro announced a new multi-year engagement through Vyoma.AI and LTN Compute to deploy additional NVIDIA B300 GPUs in Chennai.

L&T classified the engagement within its ₹2,500–5,000 crore order-value category. It builds on the previously announced plan for a 10,000-GPU AI cluster.

The announcements do not disclose the exact contract value, additional GPU count or confirmed total operating GPU count.

Sources:

L&T announcement — 23 November 2026:
https://www.larsentoubro.com/pressreleases/2026/2026-11-23-larsen-toubro-secures-large-order-for-deploying-ai-cluster

Original AI Factory announcement — 13 August 2026:
https://www.larsentoubro.com/pressreleases/2026/2026-08-13-larsen-toubro-secures-mega-order-as-part-of-a-strategic-partnership-with-together-ai-to-build-india-s-largest-nvidia-b300-ai-factory

An original Bharat Mode explainer featuring illustrative motion graphics, Natural Earth geographic data, AI-generated narration and background music. The infrastructure graphics are not documentary footage.
